column1: # This file says WHO. data/roles.csv says WHAT THE JOBS ARE. Keep the 'role'
# column below spelled the same as the 'role' column there -- that is how the
# site knows a job has nobody in it. `php tools/check.php` tells you if the two
# role     their title. People sharing a title appear together.
# handles  what to contact them about. Leave blank to hide the line.
# email    optional. Club addresses are fine; think twice about a personal one.
# group    the heading they appear under while serving.
# photo    a file in assets/images/officers/. Put the ORIGINAL in
#          assets/images/officers/raw/ and tools/prepare_officers.py makes this one.
# until    the year they stopped serving. DO NOT DELETE ANYONE -- fill this in
#          instead and they move to the past-officers list by themselves.
# Order on the page is worked out for you
